tonight.headline: A bye at QB and TE: two moves before 01:00 Wednesday
body: Bad news first: Week 7 is lost by 46.6 and Bloodsports are 1-6. As set, Week 8 projects 90.8 to Metcalf Gala's 100.4 — with Stroud on a Houston bye at QB and Likely on a Giants bye at TE.
Daniels into the QB slot and the Loveland claim take it to about 124. Then two Thursday checks: Golden and Jacobs.

case.label: The other side
case.body: Metcalf Gala start Olave on a Saints bye and bench James Cook (18.9); St. Brown and Aaron Jones are questionable. Their 100.4 will move both ways.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A lost Loveland claim — then Henry or Pitts as a free agent Wednesday morning.

doFirst.title: Claim Colston Loveland, drop C.J. Stroud
doFirst.subtitle: Carried from Monday, now confirmed: Kmet's season is over, Likely is on bye, and the flex takes a tight end. This is the one kind of claim never-resetting priority is for.

case.label: The player
case.body: 12 targets and 19.9 in Week 7 (archive), 40% of Chicago's targets in the screen. Kmet is on IR, out for the season; Loveland 'becomes Chicago's primary receiving tight end' with Caleb Williams back (FootballNation 27 Oct). Still on IPADE waivers at 12:50Z.

case.label: Why priority
case.body: Bloodsports sit 5th in an order that never resets. STRATEGY §4 spends it only on a player who starts at once: Loveland starts at TE in Week 8 and has a flex route when Likely returns.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Stroud: Week 7 cover for Daniels, Houston on bye now. Daniels has an elbow-brace risk, but free quarterbacks are plentiful (Lawrence, Murray, Penix on this wire). Not Rice, who has a season left.

case.label: If it fails
case.body: Hunter Henry (10.6) or Kyle Pitts (10.3) as free agents on Wednesday morning, still dropping Stroud — no priority spent.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Loveland draws under 6 targets in two of Weeks 8-10 (archive); or Daniels misses a game in Weeks 8-10 and the free-agent cover scores less than Stroud did that week.

doFirst.sources: FootballNation CHI–SEA 27 Oct · RotoWire (Kmet IR) · ESPN archive · wire_screen.py

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Today — before the claim runs Wed 01:00 CDMX
doFirst.title: Daniels into the QB slot, Stroud out
doFirst.subtitle: Stroud is on a Houston bye. The claim drops him at 01:00 Wednesday; Daniels has to be in the slot either way.

case.label: The move
case.body: Daniels 20.4 against Stroud's 0.0. Washington host Philadelphia Sunday night as 3.5-point favourites; the Eagles lost Barkley (back) and Pierce on Monday (PFT 26 Oct).

case.label: The risk
case.body: Daniels plays in an elbow brace after his second dislocation; doctors who have not examined him call the reinjury risk higher (Yahoo 11 Oct). Not a reason to start Stroud on a bye.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Daniels ruled out for Week 8, or the QB slot scores 0 because the swap was not made.

doFirst.sources: League file 12:50Z · PFT 26 Oct · Yahoo 11 Oct

doFirst.title: Tuten in the flex, Pickens to the bench
doFirst.subtitle: A coin flip (14.8 to 14.0) that goes to the projection — and Pickens on the bench is Golden's Thursday fallback.

case.label: The move
case.body: Tuten returns from the bye as Jacksonville's lead back; Pickens scored a TD Monday and is healthy. Inside two points the projection decides and nothing more is argued — no thesis.

case.label: Contingencies
case.body: Golden (DNP Monday) and Jacobs (tagged day-to-day) play Thursday. Check at 16:45: Golden out → Pickens in his WR slot; Jacobs out → Gordon in his RB slot.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Set it today with the Daniels swap; revisit only at Thursday's inactives.

whatWentWrong.title: Week 7 lost by 46.6 — and 12.7 points sat on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: Furia Regia 144.16, Bloodsports 97.52. Likely 3.2, Wilson 4.6 and the Jets D/ST 1 sank it; Gordon's 17.3 sat.

case.label: What happened
case.body: The best lineup from the roster was 110.2: Gordon in the flex, Pickens to Wilson's WR slot (archive). Jacobs over Gordon was a coin flip the projection won (20.1 to 17.3). No lineup closes a 46.6-point gap; this is the roster problem STRATEGY §8 names.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: 1-6. The cheapest points left are the two Week 8 zeros — QB and TE — which the Daniels swap and the Loveland claim fix.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing to re-grade; Week 7 is final in the archive (07:05Z).

whatWentWrong.title: Golden missed Monday's estimated practice — and Green Bay play Thursday
whatWentWrong.lead: DNP with shoulder and foot, three days before Carolina. Jacobs carries an unexplained day-to-day tag.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Golden was limited all of last week with the shoulder and still drew 12 targets at Detroit (archive; Yahoo/Heavy 27 Oct). Monday was a walkthrough, so the DNP is an estimate.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Both Packers start with fallbacks fixed: Pickens for Golden, Gordon for Jacobs, decided at 16:45 Thursday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Golden is limited or full Tuesday and Wednesday and plays — then the contingency simply does not fire.

whatWentWrong.sources: Packers.com 26 Oct · Yardbarker 26 Oct · Yahoo/Heavy 27 Oct
